scientific_integrity: The classification is proved analytically and reproduced with a supplementary finite checker. Literature limitations and the scope of the claims are stated explicitly.
scientific_limitations: Only normalized complex 3-by-3 nilpotents with two adjacent unit couplings and an arbitrary complex shortcut are treated.
The minimization is over involutive anticommuting similarities for the spectral operator norm; no claim is made for unrestricted similarities or larger blocks.
The 2023 factorization paper was accessible at abstract level but not in complete full text, leaving a priority risk.
Numerical diagnostics supplement the explicit analytic continuum proof; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp involution conditioning and a symmetry-breaking threshold for three-step nilpotents
